en.longDescription:
Keycloak is an open-source IAM platform for single sign-on, OAuth2, and OpenID Connect.

Includes PostgreSQL. Bootstrap admin uses SERVICE_USER_KEYCLOAK and SERVICE_PASSWORD_KEYCLOAK. Set KC_HOSTNAME via SERVICE_FQDN_KEYCLOAK when deploying behind a reverse proxy.

fr.shortDescription: Gestion des identités et des accès open source
fr.longDescription:
Keycloak est une plateforme IAM open source pour l'authentification unique, OAuth2 et OpenID Connect.

Inclut PostgreSQL. L'administrateur d'amorçage utilise SERVICE_USER_KEYCLOAK et SERVICE_PASSWORD_KEYCLOAK. Définissez KC_HOSTNAME via SERVICE_FQDN_KEYCLOAK lors d'un déploiement derrière un proxy inverse.

pt.shortDescription: Gerenciamento de identidade e acesso open-source
pt.longDescription:
Keycloak é uma plataforma IAM open-source para login único, OAuth2 e OpenID Connect.

Inclui PostgreSQL. O admin de bootstrap usa SERVICE_USER_KEYCLOAK e SERVICE_PASSWORD_KEYCLOAK. Defina KC_HOSTNAME via SERVICE_FQDN_KEYCLOAK ao implantar atrás de um proxy reverso.
